messages:
kevin-partnerships: Quick sync — starting alignment for ISV tooling certification lifecycle. Focus: LangChain + LlamaIndex adapters, gateway/orchestrator compatibility, and a joint marketplace listing + co-announcement target in mid-June. Who can own what?
lia-eng: I can take ownership of the integration smoke tests and compatibility matrix. Need clarity on supported API surfaces (chat/generation/embeddings).
sam-sre: I'll own perf/regression benchmarks across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. We'll need testbeds with representative load patterns.
nina-sdks: I'll produce adapter examples and an SDK checklist (versioning, auth, telemetry hooks). Also want an adapter test harness that runs in CI.
maya-marketing: FYI — marketing needs asset lead time (blog + joint webinar). Please flag embargo dates; marketing prefers 2 weeks lead.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace checklist: https://internal.marketplace/checklist — items: security review, billing integration, listing metadata, logo + screenshots.
kevin-partnerships: Good. Proposed owners: lia -> compatibility matrix + smoke tests, sam -> perf, nina -> SDK + CI harness, maya -> comms/calendar. I'll coordinate outreach to hardware partners (AtlasHW, VertexCompute) for validated profiles.
lia-eng: For API surfaces, start with: generation (streaming), chat (turn-level), and embeddings. Can we freeze a minimal contract: `adapter-v1` with endpoints `/generate`, `/chat`, `/embed`?
nina-sdks: That contract works. I'll scaffold `adapter-v1` and a reference repo: github.com/redwood/integrations/langchain-adapter-ref. Will include README for auth and telemetry.
sam-sre: Perf plan: 3 buckets — latency p50/p95 under 2s/8s for small models; throughput targets for batch embeddings. Need to run on small (8xA100), medium (4xH100), and CPU-quantized nodes. Will add CI matrix.
kevin-partnerships: Hardware partners: ask AtlasHW for driver/kernel patches that affect attention kernels; ask VertexCompute for validated Docker images. I'll loop them in after we have the compatibility matrix draft.
lia-eng: Suggest adding a boolean column to matrix: `requires-quantization` + `kv-cache-friendly` + `streaming-ok`. Keeps integration checklist actionable.
maya-marketing: Tentative announcement window: week of June 12. Marketing kickoff meeting next Wed. We need final logos and a short partner quote by June 1.
kevin-partnerships: On announcement — let's aim for internal freeze June 3, public embargo June 10, publish June 12. Everyone confirm if that works.
nina-sdks: Works for SDK deliverables. Will target adapter examples and CI by May 28.
sam-sre: Perf benchmarks ready by June 5. Might need a small extension if hardware partner images land late.
lia-eng: Compatibility matrix and smoke tests PRs targeted for May 24.
kevin-partnerships: Great. Next steps: 1) Owners create GH issues, label `isv-cert` + `partner` 2) nina to add CI job template 3) sam to provision perf clusters 4) maya to schedule comms calls.
nina-sdks: CI job template (draft):
```
# run integration smoke tests
./scripts/run_integration.sh --adapter=langchain --model=redwood-1-8b --env=dedicated
# perf harness
pytest tests/perf --env=perf-small --junitxml=perf-results.xml
```
kevin-partnerships: Also planning a 1-hour sync Thursday to align onboarding steps for SIs (solutions integrators) — invite list: eng leads, partner PMs, marketplace, and SRE. Will send calendar invite.
maya-marketing: I'll draft joint announcement copy and partner Qs. Also will own webinar logistics with partner comms.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: submit listing via `/marketplace/submit` at least 5 business days before publish.
lia-eng: Quick note — can we get an early drop of the partner adapter for smoke testing on Redwood Private? We need to validate networking and KMS integration.
kevin-partnerships: Noted. Nina, can we produce a Private-friendly sample (no external callbacks) by May 26?
nina-sdks: Yup — I'll add a `private-mode` example that uses customer KMS stubs and local storage.
sam-sre: Logging/perf hooks — please ensure `X-Request-Id` propagation so we can correlate traces with perf runs.
kevin-partnerships: Agree. We'll include trace hooks in the adapter contract.
maya-marketing: One ask — collect short partner quotes (1-2 sentences) by June 1. I'll follow up w/ template. :+1:
kevin-partnerships: OK team — thanks. I'll open the GH epic and post invite. If anyone can't make the Thursday sync, flag here.
lia-eng: I'm in.
sam-sre: In, may join remotely.
nina-sdks: In. Will share repo link when ready.
maya-marketing: In.
kevin-partnerships: Closing — will post GH epic ID and invite. :calendar:
